claims.statement: At the 2026-01-15 signing date there was no active market for Canton Coin: it was not listed or traded on any public exchange, so a Level 1 fair value input was unavailable.
claims.conclusion: No Level 1 input available at signing.

claims.statement: The published 0.0005 USD/CC network fee-reference price is not a fair value input under ASC 820 because it is an administratively set fee-conversion parameter rather than an exit price in an orderly arm's-length transaction.
claims.conclusion: Fee-reference price rejected as a fair value input; retained as corroborating floor only.

claims.statement: The fair value of Canton Coin at 2026-01-15 is 0.0033 USD per coin, classified Level 3, based on informal OTC secondary-market quotes and self-reported settled trades, subject to reviewer approval of the input-selection judgment.
claims.conclusion: Per-coin fair value of 0.0033 USD (Level 3), pending valuation-reviewer approval. This is the figure consumed by the referencing ASC 606 milestone package.
